rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for classical music, including both the general genre and music from the Mozart era.

example.english: I listened to classical music all the time when I was learning piano, and I still like it now.
example.traditional: 我細個學琴嗰陣成日聽古典音樂，依家都仲鍾意。

rows.note: A speaker picks this when specifically discussing music from the historical Classical period, especially Mozart and Haydn.

example.english: This lecture focuses specifically on classical music from Mozart’s period.
example.traditional: 呢場講座專門研究莫扎特年代嘅古典時期音樂。
